questions.question: מה זה Vuscan?
questions.answer: Vuscan הוא שירות מבוסס ענן לסריקה אוטומטית של פגיעויות באתרים. בתוך דקות ספורות, הוא מספק סקירה אובייקטיבית של האבטחה של המשאב שלך: החל מפורטים פתוחים ורכיבים לא מעודכנים ועד לפגיעויות ידועות (CVEs). השירות שימושי במיוחד עבור אלה who want to prevent attacks before they are exploited by malicious actors — quickly, simply, and without unnecessary costs.

questions.question: האם אני צריך להתקין משהו?
questions.answer: לא. Vuscan פועל entirely in the cloud.

questions.question: האם אתם סורקים רשתות פנימיות או כתובות מקומיות?
questions.answer: לא. We specialize exclusively in external analysis of public resources.

questions.question: כמה זמן לוקחת סריקה?
questions.answer: Typically, scanning takes from 30 seconds to 5 minutes, depending on the size of the site, the number of services, and current load.

questions.question: האם אוכל לשמור או להוריד את הדוח?
questions.answer: כן. לאחר השלמת הסריקה, אתה can download the report or view it directly in your browser.

questions.question: למי Vuscan מיועד?
questions.answer:
Vuscan is designed for those who value security and speed. It will be useful for:

  • Website owners and administrators;
  • DevOps and technical teams;
  • Small and medium businesses, especially those without a dedicated security specialist;
  • Startups and freelancers;
  • Anyone who wants to conduct a quick security audit without complexity or high costs.

questions.question: כמה בטוח להשתמש ב-Vuscan?
questions.answer: It is absolutely safe. Vuscan does not integrate into your system, does not launch active attacks, and does not require access to internal data. We perform only external analysis to help you protect yourself in advance.

questions.question: האם יש אפשרות להחזר?
questions.answer:
We provide information services upon your request, the result of which is not subject to cancellation or revocation after provision.

Since the service is considered to have been rendered at the time the result is issued, no refund is provided.

about-scanner.content:
סורק פגיעויות המבוסס על ניתוח חיצוני

הכלי שלנו מבצע סריקה intelligently של אתרים, ומזהה סיכונים הנראים not only to attackers but also to search engines. This allows vulnerabilities to be detected before they can be exploited.

הסורק מנתח נתונים זמינים publicly about your resource - the same data accessible externally without authentication. This includes:

  • Open administrative panels
  • Indexable directories and hidden files
  • Vulnerable input points (XSS, SQL injections)
  • Publicly accessible confidential data

How is our approach better than traditional scanners?

Unlike classic scanners that only work from inside the system or require server access, our tool:

  • Requires no client-side installation
  • Analyzes websites as seen by external users or bots
  • Identifies information leakage risks and access misconfigurations
  • Helps protect against unauthorized indexing and digital reconnaissance

Why is this important?

Our approach helps companies timely identify risks that might be visible to external attackers. This is crucial for protecting business, reputation, and customers. Such auditing enables:

  • Understanding what company data, panels and vulnerabilities are publicly visible online without login
  • Closing security gaps before they're discovered - protecting before search engine indexing or attacker exploitation
  • Enhancing cybersecurity - reducing risks of data leaks and external interference
  • Meeting compliance requirements - assisting with security audits and standards adherence

levels:
תיקיות פתוחות באתרים

פגיעות critical that allows attackers to access internal files, project structure, and confidential information.

If web server directory listing is enabled, any user can browse files directly through a browser. This may include: website backups, configuration files, scripts, logs, and even private documents.

This error most commonly occurs on sites with misconfigured Apache, Nginx or other web servers. In most cases it remains unnoticed until a data leak or attack occurs.

Why this is dangerous for your site:

  • Source code and service scripts leakage
  • Preparation for attacks using known project structure
  • Information gathering for vulnerability exploitation and further hacking
Check now if your directory is open to the entire internet - Vuscan scanner will help identify such threats.

פאנלי ניהול פתוחים או מוגנים poorly ב-CMS websites

One of the most common entry points for hackers.

Many website owners forget to change default admin panel paths (e.g., /wp-admin, /administrator, /admin.php) or don't configure IP protection, two-factor authentication and other security measures.

If admin access is open and not properly secured, an attacker can:

  • Brute-force login credentials
  • Gain full control over the website
  • Upload malicious scripts and infect the site with viruses
  • CMS like WordPress, Joomla, Bitrix, Drupal are especially vulnerable in default installations without additional protection
Vuscan scanning will help detect open admin panels and management access points before hackers find them.

XSS (Cross-Site Scripting) and SQL injections

Some of the most dangerous vulnerabilities in web applications. They are directly related to insufficient user input filtering.

SQL injections allow attackers to execute arbitrary SQL queries to the database, which can lead to data leakage or deletion.

XSS attacks inject malicious scripts into input fields (search, comment forms, etc.) that then execute in other users' browsers.

Consequences:

  • Theft of personal data, logins and passwords
  • Access to admin panel
  • Full control over the database
  • Infection of site visitors with malicious code
Vuscan checks common input points and detects active XSS and SQL vulnerabilities before they can be exploited.

Many websites mistakenly leave internal technical files accessible online, which should remain private. If exposed, anyone—including hackers—can view or download them, potentially revealing passwords, access details, settings, and other sensitive data. Just one such file can grant full control over a site and lead to its compromise.

Scan your site with Vuscan—the tool quickly detects if confidential data is exposed.
